insurer: Raheja QBE General Insurance Company Limited

room_rent.note: If higher room taken, all other expenses (except medicines) reimbursed proportionately

icu.note: Proportionate deduction applies if ICU charges exceed limit

copayment.note: Mandatory 5% co-pay applies to every admissible claim for all insured persons

sub_limits.display: Cataract capped; modern treatments at 50% SI
sub_limits.note: Cataract: 25% of SI or ₹40,000 per eye per year, whichever lower; modern treatments (robotic surgery, etc.) capped at 50% of SI

initial_waiting.note: Does not apply to accidents; waived if continuously covered for 12+ months

ped_waiting.note: Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability/migration

specific_disease_waiting.note: 24mo: cataract, hernia, hydrocele, piles, varicose veins, etc. 36mo: joint replacement, age-related osteoarthritis/osteoporosis

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded (Excl18); ectopic pregnancy is covered

cumulative_bonus.note: Option 1: SI increases 5% per claim-free year, max 50%; reduced at same rate on claim. Option 2: 1.5% premium discount instead

restoration.note: No restoration/reset benefit mentioned in policy wording

day_care.note: All day-care treatments covered; 24-hour minimum not required for day-care

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation and OPD treatment explicitly excluded (Section 7.18)

ayush.note: Inpatient AYUSH treatment covered up to sum insured in recognised AYUSH hospitals

organ_donor.note: No mention of organ donor expense cover in policy wording

ambulance.note: Road ambulance covered up to ₹2,000 per hospitalisation

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatments listed (robotic surgery, oral chemo, stem cell, etc.) covered up to 50% of SI

consumables.note: Gloves, masks, consumables listed in Annexure-A List I as non-payable items

global_cover.note: Treatment must be taken within India only (Section 10.7)

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months no claim contestable except fraud; applies separately to enhanced SI portions

grace_period.note: 30 days for yearly/half-yearly/quarterly; 15 days for monthly premium mode

free_look.note: Applicable only at inception, not on renewals or porting

portability.note: Portability to other insurers permitted with continuity of waiting period credits

notable_exclusions.display: Domiciliary & OPD, maternity, infertility/IVF, overseas treatment, refractive error <7.5D, adventure sports (professional)

optional_riders.note: No optional riders or add-ons described in the policy wording
